messages.author: 33dc9c6d026ee296
messages.subject: old apps not working?
parts:
Hi Folks,

Today I had occasion to run an app that I had deployed to shinyappd some while back, maybe in Fall 2014.  The app cam up but did not function correctly.  I redeployed the app (no chang ein code) and all was well.  Has anyone experienced similar behavior?  Do we need to update apps that were deployed when shinyapps was in alpha/beta stage?

Homer

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] old apps not working?
parts: Homer, its quite possible. I know there has been MANY changes to shiny itself since we first launched, so its possible we've introduced an incompatibility with very old applications. What URLs are not working?
